test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

Walking zones have been demarcated using paints and cones by the municipal corporation.

options.text: Walking zones are demarcating the municipal corporation using paints and cones.
The municipal corporation is demarcating walking zones using paints and cones.
The municipal corporation has demarcated walking zones using paints and cones.
The municipal corporation will demarcate walking zones using paints and cones.

solution:
​The correct answer is **'****The municipal corporation has demarcated walking zones using paints and cones.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence in **passive voice **has the following structure - 

 
 
• **Subject *(walking zones)* + have been + past participle *(demarcated)* + using paints and cones + *by* + object *(the municipal corporation)***
 
 
 
• When **past participle **is used in the passive voice, the tense takes the form of **present perfect (has demarcated) **in the active voice. 
 
• There is also an interchange in the subject and object. 
 
• Thus, the sentence in active voice will have the following structure - 
 
 
• **Object (*The municipal corporation*) + has + past participle (*demarcated*) + subject (*walking zones*) + using paints and cones**
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct active sentence is - The municipal corporation has demarcated walking zones using paints and cones.
 
• This makes **option 3 **the correct answer.
